page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at left; below it a central engraving (emblem picture) with no text inside; below the engraving a centred verse of four lines in italic; catchword at lower right.

l.i: Si censura virum damnet nil tale merentem,
Sontemq; absoluat, non leue crimen habet.
Non igitur ludex audito finiat vno,
Sed ius audito dicat vtroq; viro.

page.notes: The engraving shows a seated judge at a desk with a book, a devil on the right handing him a purse, a ladder leading up to clouds and a sun, and a bookcase and city view behind. No printed text inside the picture. The verse lines are set with indents as printed; the first two lines and last two lines are each a verse pair. The running head is printed in small capitals "EMBLEMA" above the large-capital title line "AVDIATVR ALTERA PARS."
